ll8.info.actuallyadditions.bowl_on_water: Right-click a water source block with an empty Bowl.
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.coffee_machin: Power a Coffee Maker, fill with water, add Coffee Beans and Empty Cup, optionally ingredients.
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.crystallized: Throw Crystallized Canola Seeds into a Refined Canola Oil source, then scoop with a Bucket.
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.empowered: Throw Empowered Canola Seeds into a Crystallized Oil source, then scoop with a Bucket.
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.fill_from_pre: Put Canola in a powered Canola Press, then right-click with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.actuallyadditions.refined_from_: Fill a Fermenting Barrel with Canola Oil, then right-click with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.advanced_ae.encode_in_adv_patte: Right-click with an Advanced Pattern Encoder, place a Processing Pattern and take the result.
ll8.info.advanced_ae.fill_bucket_from_re: Create Quantum Infusion in a powered Reaction Chamber and right-click it with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.ae2.cut_with_quartz_knife: Right-click with a Certus or Nether Quartz Cutting Knife, add a metal ingot, type a name and take the result.
ll8.info.ae2.encode_in_pattern_terminal: In ME Pattern Encoding Terminal pick Smithing Table or Stonecutter mode, fill the recipe and encode a Blank Pattern.
ll8.info.ae2.p2p_attunement: Right-click an ME P2P Tunnel with a Chest, Torch, or Redstone Dust, then break it.
ll8.info.ae2netanalyser.loot_bundle_rand: Right-click a Loot bundle from FTB Quests for 3 random items; ME Tick Profiler is a rare pick. Mobs don't drop bundles.
ll8.info.aether.bee_queen_christmas_trad: Hit mobs with a Candy Cane Sword to get Candy Canes.
ll8.info.aether.fill_skyroot_bucket: Craft an empty Skyroot Bucket, then right-click a water or Powder Snow block to fill it.
ll8.info.aether.ftb_quest_obsidian_set: Wear Phoenix Gloves and get wet to convert them to Obsidian Gloves.
ll8.info.aether.halloween_kill_in_aether: Kill mobs in the Aether between October 21 and November 9 for a chance to drop Candy Canes.
ll8.info.aether.scoop_mob_with_skyroot_b: Fill a Skyroot Bucket with water, then right-click a fish or axolotl to scoop it up.
ll8.info.aether.till_with_hoe: Right-click Aether Dirt or Aether Grass with a hoe to till it.
ll8.info.alexscaves.bucket_acid_radgill: Fill a bucket from an acid pool in the Toxic Caves, then right-click a Radgill with it.
ll8.info.alexscaves.bucket_soda_sweetish: Fill a bucket from a Purple Soda source in the Candy Cavity, then right-click a Sweetish Fish.
ll8.info.alexscaves.bucket_water_mob: Right-click a live Gossamer Worm, Lanternfish, Sea Pig or Tripodfish with a Bucket of Water.
ll8.info.alexscaves.craft_cave_map: Surround a Cave Codex with eight Paper on a 3x3 crafting grid.
ll8.info.alexscaves.fill_bucket_purple_s: Right-click a Purple Soda source block in the Candy Cavity with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.alexscaves.gingerbarrel_assembl: Place a Gingerbarrel near a Gingerbread Town and let wild Gingerbread Men fill it with sweets to get armor.
ll8.info.alexscaves.gm_chicken_swab_spaw: Use Mob Swab on mob, craft GM Chicken Feed from used swab, seeds, Fluid XP Bucket; feed adult Chicken.
ll8.info.alexscaves.gummy_bear_licoroot: Feed a Gummy Bear a lasting-effect potion; when it scratches Licoroot, it drops flavored Jelly Beans.
ll8.info.alexscaves.spelunkery_table_tra: Place a Cave Tablet and Paper on a Spelunkery Table and solve the guessing minigame to get a Cave Codex.
ll8.info.amendments.fill_bottle_from_dye: Right-click Water Cauldron with dye, then right-click it with Glass Bottle.
ll8.info.apotheosis.drop_from_invader_bo: Kill Apothic Invader bosses for a rare chance of a Music Disc.
ll8.info.apotheosis.endless_invader_gate: Clear the Gateway of the Apothic Pinnacle, open the Endless Gateway of Apothic Invaders pearl it gives, reach wave 100.
ll8.info.apothic_compats.apotheosis_affi: Open loot chests in any structure; Apotheosis adds random affixed items to them.
ll8.info.appmek.attune_p2p_with_chemical: Place an ordinary ME P2P Tunnel and right-click it with any Mekanism chemical tank.
ll8.info.ars_additions.convert_apparatus: Sneak right-click an Ars Nouveau Enchanting Apparatus with a Wixie Charm to upgrade it.
ll8.info.ars_additions.imbue_spell_parch: Inscribe a spell on Spell Parchment, place in Imbuement Chamber with empty pedestals, supply Source until complete.
ll8.info.ars_additions.take_from_warp_ne: Find a Nexus Tower or Arcane Library and right-click its Warp Nexus to take the Nexus Warp Scroll.
ll8.info.ars_elemental.dungeon_chest_loo: Find a ready-made spell tome in vanilla structure chests: dungeons, temples, strongholds, mineshafts, more.
ll8.info.ars_elemental.imbue_source_gem: Put Source Gem in Imbuement Chamber; place Wither Skeleton Skull, Bone Meal, Golden Apple on Arcane Pedestals.
ll8.info.ars_elemental.ritual_of_binding: Place the Binding ritual tablet in a Ritual Brazier and activate it near a Flarecannon, Flashjack or Siren.
ll8.info.ars_elemental.siren_charm_on_pr: Right-click a Prismarine block with a Siren Charm to create a Siren Shrine.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.capturing_drygmy_eg: Kill Drygmy yourself with weapon enchanted with Capturing; rare egg drop.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.charm_converts_bloc: Right-click Cauldron with Wixie Charm, Mossy Cobblestone with Drygmy Charm, or flower with Whirlisprig Charm.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.dungeon_chest_rare_: Find this rare item in vanilla structure chests: dungeons, mineshafts, temples, strongholds, End cities, more.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.gift_starbuncle_gol: Give Gold Nugget to rare red-and-purple Starbuncle; ordinary ones give only shards.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.mob_swab_gm_chicken: Use Mob Swab on Alakarkinos, craft GM Chicken Feed from used swab, seeds, Fluid XP Bucket; feed adult Chicken.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.quest_reward: Complete the FTB Quests task in the Ars Nouveau chapter asking for an Annotated Codex.
ll8.info.ars_nouveau.ritual_of_binding_g: Summon Amethyst Golem with Charm, put Binding in Ritual Brazier within 5 blocks and start it.
ll8.info.ars_technica.enchanting_apparat: Put Wrench in Enchanting Apparatus; set Gold Ingot, Calibrated Precision Mechanism, Manipulation Essence on pedestals.
ll8.info.arsdelight.serve_from_chimera_f: Cook Honey Glazed Chimera in a Cooking Pot, place it and right-click with an empty Bowl.
ll8.info.arsdelight.serve_from_wilden_sa: Place Wilden Salad and right-click with Bowl for Bowl of Wilden Salad, or Chimera Horn for Horn Roll.
ll8.info.arseng.attune_p2p_tunnel: Right-click an ME P2P Tunnel with a Source Gem for the Source tunnel or a spell book for the Spell tunnel.
ll8.info.ascended_quark.aether_dungeon_c: Search ordinary room chests in the Silver Dungeon in the Aether for a very rare drop.
ll8.info.ascended_quark.scoop_mob_with_b: Right-click Blue Swet or Golden Swet with Bucket or Skyroot Bucket, or Slime with Skyroot Bucket only.
ll8.info.ascended_quark.valkyrie_loot_qu: Quest reward for Valkyrie gear from the Silver Dungeon; also very rare in Bronze and Silver Dungeon room chests.
ll8.info.avaritia_integration.laser_dril: Place a laser lens in a Fluid Laser Base, power Industrial Foregoing Laser Drills at it, then right-click with a bucket.
ll8.info.bigreactors.cryomisi: Powered Fluidizer with two Solid Injectors: Redstone Dust in one, Snow Block in other; pipe Cryomisi to tank, bucket.
ll8.info.bigreactors.fluidizer_melt_ingo: Put Yellorium, Cyanite, Blutonium or Magentite Ingot in powered Fluidizer Solid Injector; pipe fluid to tank, bucket.
ll8.info.bigreactors.reactor_waste_from_: Burn Verderium; a Reactor Fuel Injection Port (Reinforced) in Outlet Mode sends Rossinite to a tank.
ll8.info.bigreactors.redfrigium: Powered Fluidizer with two Fluid Injectors: Cryomisi in one, Tangerium in other; pipe Redfrigium to tank, bucket.
ll8.info.bigreactors.tangerium: Powered Fluidizer w/ 2 Solid Injectors: Anglesite (PbSO4) in one, Ender Pearls in other; pipe Tangerium to tank, bucket.
ll8.info.bigreactors.verderium: Powered Fluidizer + 2 Solid Injectors: Yellorium Ingots in one, Blutonium in the other; pipe Verderium to tank, bucket.
ll8.info.brewinandchewin.serve_from_plac: Cook Pot of Fiery Fondue in Cooking Pot, place it, then right-click it with a bowl.
ll8.info.buildinggadgets2.save_in_templa: Place Template Manager, insert Copy Paste Gadget with copied structure and paper, then click Save.
ll8.info.butchercraft.chicken: Right-click a chicken with a Butcher Knife; use Glass Bottle, Shears then Gutting Knife on a Butcher Block.
ll8.info.butchercraft.livestock: Right-click cow, pig, sheep or goat with Butcher Knife; hang carcass on Meat Hook; use Bucket, Skinning Knife, Bone Saw.
ll8.info.butchercraft.place_skull_from_c: Place Cow Head on Butcher Block, use Gutting Knife four times to get Cow Skull, then place it.
ll8.info.cataclysm.bucket_tamed_baby_lev: Defeat The Leviathan, hatch the Abyssal Egg, feed the Baby Leviathan Tropical Fish, then scoop it with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.cataclysm.bucket_tamed_modern_r: Kill an Ancient Remnant for Skull, summon a Modern Remnant with it, feed it a Sniffer Egg, then collect in a Bucket.
ll8.info.cataclysm.bucket_tamed_netherit: Craft a Netherite Effigy, summon a Netherite Ministrosity with it, feed it a Lava Power Cell, then collect in a Bucket.
ll8.info.chemlib.bucket_from_liquifier: Build a Chemical Liquifier, feed ChemLib chemical items with FE, then right-click with an Empty Bucket.
ll8.info.chemlib.mine_with_ie_excavator: Find a Bituminous Coal vein with a Core Sample Drill and run a powered Excavator over it to dig Phosphorus Dust.
ll8.info.chemlib.press_plate_in_ie_metal: Feed Cobalt, Osmium or Zinc Ingots into a powered Immersive Engineering Metal Press with Metal Press Mold: Plate.
ll8.info.chickens.boss_drop_skin_crate: Kill an Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden or Elder Guardian.
ll8.info.chickens.catch_with_catcher: Craft a Chicken Catcher and right-click a grown chicken with it.
ll8.info.chickens.chemical_chicken_lays_: Breed a chemical chicken in a Breeder and collect its egg.
ll8.info.chickens.chicken_dies_in_lava: Push a chicken into lava to get a cooked Lava Chicken.
ll8.info.chickens.douse_chicken_for_spaw: Use an Avian Dousing Machine to turn a Chicken into a Spawn Egg.
ll8.info.chickens.fluid_chicken_lays_egg: Breed a fluid chicken in a Breeder and collect its egg.
ll8.info.chickens.loot_bundle_random_pic: Open Loot bundles from mob drops or crafted from 9 Loot bundle fragments; each gives 3 random items, rarely a Gas Egg.
ll8.info.chickens.robot_upgrade_and_viru: Find a Smart Chicken and right-click it repeatedly with roost upgrades.
ll8.info.chickens.tame_then_catch_mega_c: Feed a Mega Chicken seeds until tamed, then catch with Chicken Catcher.
ll8.info.chipped.alchemy_bench: Place an ore or valuable material block in the Alchemy Bench and select your desired variant.
ll8.info.chipped.botanist_workbench: Place a block in the Botanist Workbench to transform it into any decorative variant.
ll8.info.chipped.carpenters_table: Place a wood or plank block in the Carpenter's Table and select your desired variant.
ll8.info.chipped.glassblower: Place a glass or glass pane block in the Glassblower and select your desired variant.
ll8.info.chipped.loom_table: Place wool or carpet in the Loom Table to create different variants.
ll8.info.chipped.mason_table: Place a stone or stone variant block in the Mason Table and select your desired variant.
ll8.info.chipped.tinkering_table: Craft a Tinkering Table. Put blocks into it to select their variants.
ll8.info.cobblemon.drop_from_defeated_po: Defeat wild Pokemon for rare drops (2.5-25% chance).
ll8.info.cobblemon.evolve_shelmet_with_l: Keep Karrablast in party, then right-click Shelmet with Link Cable to evolve it.
ll8.info.cobblemon.slather_saccharine_lo: Right-click Saccharine Log with Honey Bottle to slather it for honey and Pokemon attraction.
ll8.info.cobblemon.snorlax_drop_or_eat_a: Defeat Snorlax, Munchlax, Garbodor, or Trubbish for 5–2.5% drop, or eat apples for 2.5%.
ll8.info.crabbersdelight.bucket_crab: Right-click a Crabber's Delight Crab, not a Quark crab, with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.crabbersdelight.coconut_falls_o: Stand under hanging Coconut with no helmet; break the block above or hit it with projectile to make it fall on you.
ll8.info.create.convert_contact_by_eleva: Put Redstone Contacts on the shaft wall facing the cabin's contact and assemble the elevator to make Elevator Contacts.
ll8.info.create.encase_with_casing: Right-click a Shaft, Cogwheel or Large Cogwheel with Andesite or Brass Casing.
ll8.info.create.shop_table_cloth: Price a Table Cloth, link it to a Stock Ticker with a Stock Keeper, then right-click the Table Cloth with an empty hand.
ll8.info.create.wrench_pickup_chest_cart: Assemble a contraption onto a Minecart with Chest at a powered Cart Assembler then right-click the cart with a Wrench.
ll8.info.create_connected.creeper_killed: Get a Skeleton to shoot a Creeper dead; it drops a random Music Disc.
ll8.info.create_connected.encase_with_ca: Place a Cross Connector, then right-click it while holding an Andesite or Brass Casing.
ll8.info.create_enchantment_industry.fil: Pour Bottles o' Enchanting into an Item Drain, pipe the Liquid Experience into a Fluid Tank and fill a bucket.
ll8.info.create_enchantment_industry.inf: Pour Infused Dragon's Breath into an Item Drain, pipe the fluid into a Fluid Tank and fill a bucket.
ll8.info.create_enchantment_industry.mix: Mix Apotheosis rarity materials in a Basin under a Mechanical Mixer, then right-click the Basin with an empty Bucket.
Put Gem Dust into a Basin under a Mechanical Mixer, then right-click the Basin with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.create_enchantment_industry.pla: Right-click an Item Drain's top with a Mechanical Grindstone in hand.
ll8.info.create_mechanical_chicken.fill_: Mix seeds and water in a Basin under a Mechanical Mixer, then right-click the Basin with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.createaddition.bioethanol: Mix Sugar, Cinder Flour and 2 Biomass in a Basin under a Mechanical Mixer, then right-click the Basin with a Bucket.
ll8.info.createaddition.seed_oil: Press any seeds in a Basin under a Mechanical Press, then fill a Bucket from it.
ll8.info.createcasing.apply_casing: Right-click a placed shaft or gear with any Casing block to encase it.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.distill_: Pump Crude Oil into a heated Distillation Tower to make Diesel or Gasoline, then fill a bucket with a Spout.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.ferment_: Put food with bone meal in a Basin with a Basin Lid to ferment Ethanol, then fill a bucket with a Spout.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.mix_conc: Mix concrete powder with water in a Basin and Mechanical Mixer to make Cement, then fill a bucket with a Spout.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.mix_oil_: Mix Plant Oil and Ethanol in a Basin with a Mechanical Mixer to make Biodiesel, then fill a bucket with a Spout.
ll8.info.createdieselgenerators.press_se: Press a seed in a Basin with a Mechanical Press to make Plant Oil, then fill a bucket with a Spout.
ll8.info.crittersandcompanions.bucket_wa: Right-click a live Dumbo Octopus, Koi Fish, or Sea Bunny in water with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.deep_aether.bucket_aerglow_fish: Right-click an Aerglow Fish in Aether water with a water bucket.
ll8.info.deep_aether.bucket_quicksand: Right-click Virulent Quicksand in a Yagroot Swamp with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.deep_aether.craft_aerwhale_sadd: Craft Aerwhale Saddle on a crafting table: 3 Leather, 2 Stratus Ingot, 1 Sun Core.
ll8.info.deep_aether.dungeon_reward_ches: Open the reward chest after defeating an Aether dungeon boss.
ll8.info.deep_aether.fish_in_aether: Fish in Aether water with an ordinary fishing rod.
ll8.info.deep_aether.flawless_boss_drop: Kill the Slider or Eye of the Storm without taking any unblocked hits.
ll8.info.deep_aether.halloween_slider_dr: Kill the Slider during Halloween when Deep Aether's Halloween content is enabled.
ll8.info.deep_aether.shovel_golden_grass: Right-click a Golden Grass Block in Golden Heights with any shovel.
ll8.info.deeperdarker.dye_in_crafting_gr: Put a Sculk Transmitter and a dye in a crafting grid to dye it.
ll8.info.displaydelight.place_the_food: Place food on a Food Plate by right-clicking with food in hand, then mine with Silk Touch.
ll8.info.divinerpg.catch_fish_with_water: Right-click the Cauldron Fish with a Water Bucket to catch it.
ll8.info.divinerpg.fill_bucket_from_tar_: Right-click a Smoldering Tar source with an empty Bucket; tar lakes spawn in dry Overworld biomes like deserts.
ll8.info.divinerpg.light_the_portal: These are portal dimensions; build the matching frame and light it with the correct item.
ll8.info.divinerpg.throw_item_into_fire: Drop the right material on burning fire blocks to convert them into colored flames.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_arcana_merchant: Find an Arcana merchant in the dungeon, open its cage with a pick or the right crop, then trade.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_iceika_groglin: Trade Olivine with Groglin villagers in the Iceika Groglin village.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_iceika_tinkerer: Trade the plain weapon and a Snowflake with the Workshop Tinkerer in Iceika.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_jack_o_man: Find a Jack o'Man in Overworld forests, swamps or dripstone caves and trade.
ll8.info.divinerpg.trade_vethea_hunger: Trade with The Hunger in ceiling huts on Vethea's first layer.
ll8.info.dndesires.spout_fill_bucket: Mix the milkshake in a Basin under a Mechanical Mixer, then fill an empty bucket under a Spout.
ll8.info.doggytalents.dog_fetch_returns_: Craft a Frisbee and throw it at your dog to get the Drool Frisbee.
ll8.info.doggytalents.dog_wearing_bunny_: Craft Bunny Ears, put them on your dog, and let it kill mobs for an Easter Egg Candy.
ll8.info.doggytalents.dog_wearing_wig_ki: Craft a Wig, put it on your dog, and let it kill mobs for a Chopin music disc.
ll8.info.doggytalents.sniffer_dog_return: Craft a Scent Treat, right-click a block to sample its scent, then right-click a Sniffer Dog.
ll8.info.doggytalents.unpod_edamame: Craft Edamame and right-click it in the air to pop the pod into Unpodded Edamame.
ll8.info.draconicevolution.bind_unbound_: Right-click in the air holding an Un-Bound Dislocator to bind it.
ll8.info.draconicevolution.reaper_kill_d: Kill mobs with a Reaper-enchanted sword for a rare chance of a Soul.
ll8.info.dungeonsdelight.hit_silverfish_: Hold Amethyst Rock Candy and hit a live Silverfish with it.
ll8.info.dungeonsdelight.serve_from_feas: Cook the dish's same-named block in the Monster Pot, place it and right-click it with a Bowl to take a serving.
ll8.info.dungeonsdelight.slice_pizza_wit: Cook a Polterghast Pizza in the Monster Pot, place it, then right-click it with a knife to cut a slice.
ll8.info.earthmobsmod.capture_teacup_pig: Hold a Flower Pot and right-click a Teacup Pig.
ll8.info.earthmobsmod.capture_tiny_tropi: Right-click a tiny Tropical Slime with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.earthmobsmod.horned_sheep_rams_: Hit a Horned Sheep and stand in front of Stone, a log, ore or Packed Ice so its charge breaks off a Sheep Horn Flute.
ll8.info.enderio.coordinate_selector_wit: Carry paper and right-click a block while holding an Ender IO Coordinate Selector.
ll8.info.enderio.fill_from_vat: Put base fluid and two reagents in VAT, wait for fermentation, then right-click with empty bucket.
ll8.info.enderio.fill_from_xp_tank: Collect XP Juice in an XP Vacuum or XP Obelisk, pipe it into a Fluid Tank and fill a Bucket from it.
ll8.info.enderio.mystical_silicon_essenc: Grow Silicon Seeds and craft 3 Silicon Essence in a row to get silicon.
ll8.info.endersdelight.serve_from_stuffe: Cook Stuffed Shulker in a Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot, place it and right-click with Shulker Bowl to take a serving.
ll8.info.energizedpower.fill_dirty_water: Fill Advanced Crusher with water, run recipes to make Dirty Water, pipe to Fluid Filler with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.energizedpower.fill_liquid_xp_i: Put an XP Drain on a Fluid Tank, pipe Liquid XP into a powered Fluid Filler holding an empty Bucket to collect it.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.awaken_enig: Find a Dormant Eye in a loot chest, then hold it and right-click to awaken it.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.charge_core: In your inventory, hold an Astral Pearl and right-click it onto an Etherium Core.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.drop_on_dea: Die while wearing the Ring of the Seven Curses with keepInventory off.
Die with an Enigmatic Amulet equipped while carrying items.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.end_city_ch: Equip the Ring of the Seven Curses and open End City treasure chests.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.first_ichor: Open Overworld loot chests; your first Nectar of Ichor becomes Enchanted Nectar of Ichor (once per player).
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.nether_ches: In the Nether, land many hits while at 55% health or less, then open any loot chest.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.purificatio: Brew Honey Bottle with Pure Heart in a Brewing Stand.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.quest_rewar: Complete the optional Ring of the Seven Curses quest in the Adventure chapter of the FTB Quests book.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.twisted: Brew Awkward Potion with Eye of Ender, then brew the result with Twisted Heart in a Brewing Stand.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.use_bless_s: Wear the Ring of the Seven Curses and die holding a Holy Stone; in Hardcore, right-click instead.
ll8.info.enigmaticlegacyplus.wormhole: Brew Awkward Potion with Eye of Ender, then brew the result with Fermented Spider Eye in a Brewing Stand.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.boss_dies_wit: Kill an Eternal Starlight boss without hitting it to receive a Loot Bag instead of a Loot Chest.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.break_leaves_: Break leaf blocks in the Eternal Starlight dimension for a rare Blossom of Stars drop.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.bucket_the_fi: Right-click Luminaris, Luminofish, or Rookfish in Eternal Starlight seas with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.drop_while_fi: Hit mobs in melee while carrying a Mana Crystal; dropped shards must be caught by a Hopper.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.drown_a_rookf: Get a Rookfish out of water and let it drown for a 10% chance at Music Disc Brisk.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.fill_bucket_w: Right-click an Ether source block in the Ether River biome with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.ignite_stella: Right-click Stellagmite with flint and steel, fire charge, blaze rod, or Thermal Springstone Ingot.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.mine_with_res: Craft a Resonance Enchanted Book at Pastel's Enchanter, enchant a pickaxe, mine Budding Thioquartz in geodes.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.moth_kills_gl: Tame a Crystallized Moth and let it kill a Gleech for a chance at Music Disc Sacred Desert.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.ram_deer_into: Hit an Aurora Deer to make it charge into a log behind you so it drops an Antler sickle.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.throw_accesso: Drop an accessory into Ether and wait five seconds for it to become Butterfly Wings Amulet.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.throw_disc_in: Drop a music disc into Ether and wait five seconds for it to become a different disc.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.throw_shatter: Right-click a Shattered Sword with its blade to throw the blade like a trident.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.till_or_flatt: Right-click Nightfall Dirt with a hoe to till it or with a shovel to make a path.
ll8.info.eternal_starlight.trade_with_bo: Boarwarf Silversmith cannot be encountered in Eternal Starlight 0.9.0 survival mode.
ll8.info.evilcraft.chest_loot_broom: Craft a Rod, a Brush, and a Cap Broom Part, then combine all three in a crafting grid.
ll8.info.evilcraft.chest_loot_condensed_: Find Condensed Blood in loot chests throughout the world.
ll8.info.evilcraft.fill_bucket_from_tank: Right-click a Dark Tank containing Blood with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.evilcraft.spirit_portal_book_or: Right-click an animal with a Darkened Apple; when it dies from Paling, throw a Book into the Spirit Portal.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.blas: Melt Blaze Powder in an Electric Blast Furnace and empty its fluid output with a bucket.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.cann: Put Tin Cans and food into a Steel or Electric Canning Machine to make Canned Food.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.cat_: Tame a cat and throw a Nano Helmet or Quantum Nano Helmet near it; the cat will return it.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.chem: Put Nitrogen, Phosphoric Acid, and Potassium Hydroxide in a Chemical Reactor; click its fluid outlet with bucket.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.comp: Fill Bronze, Steel, or Electric Composter with Manure fluid, Bone Meal, Mulch; click its fluid output with bucket.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.dist: Distill water in a Distillery and empty its fluid output with a bucket.

ll8.info.extended_industrialization.reac: Put Bone Meal and Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Reactor and empty its fluid output with a bucket.
Put water, Hydrochloric Acid, and Granite Dust in a Chemical Reactor; click its fluid output slot with an empty bucket.
Put Potassium Chloride, Hydrogen, and Oxygen in a Chemical Reactor; click its fluid output slot with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.extended_industrialization.wast: Place a Waste Collector under animals and empty its fluid output with a bucket.
ll8.info.extendedae.pack_device_with_tap: Right-click any ME Interface, Pattern Provider, or Drive with ME Packing Tape.
ll8.info.extradelight.separate_egg_in_mi: Place a Mixing Bowl and right-click it while holding an egg.
ll8.info.farmersdelight.serving_from_fea: Place the whole feast block of the same name and right-click it holding an empty Bowl.
ll8.info.fishofthieves.brush_ocean_ruin_: Use a Brush on Suspicious Sand or Suspicious Gravel in an ocean ruin.
ll8.info.fishofthieves.bucket_live_fish: Right-click a Fish of Thieves fish in water while holding a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.fishofthieves.eat_pineapple: Eat a Pineapple or a Crownless Pineapple by holding right-click.
ll8.info.forbidden_arcanus.boss_catcher: Put a Quantum Catcher in a tier 4 Hephaestus Forge, the rest on pedestals; right-click with a Blacksmith Gavel.
ll8.info.forbidden_arcanus.whirlwind_pri: Put White Wool in a tier 3 Hephaestus Forge, Elementarium as its enhancer; right-click with a Blacksmith Gavel.
ll8.info.framedblocks.encode_in_framing_: Craft and place a Framing Saw, right-click it, and encode a Blank Pattern using the AE2 Pattern Encoding tab.
ll8.info.frightsdelight.lollipop_mold_ha: Place a Lollipop Mold, right-click it 4 times with Bone Shards, add a syrup bottle, and collect lollipops when hardened.
ll8.info.frightsdelight.ring_candy_mold_: Cut Clay with a Glass Bottle on a Cutting Board, smelt to a Ring Candy Mold, place it, then right-click with syrup.
ll8.info.gag.lightning_strikes_dropped_h: Drop a Hearthstone next to a Lightning Rod during a thunderstorm or throw a Channeling Trident at the rod.
ll8.info.georenouveau.awaken_budding_geo: Dig to a Budding GeOre, place Ritual Brazier nearby, use Awakening Tablet, right-click, then kill the Golem.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.brew_protein: Brew Protein by placing Banana traps in the bottom slots of a brewing stand with Honey Bottle on top.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.buy_from_wander: Buy a Banana trap from a Wandering Trader for 3 emeralds.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.capture_steve_i: Craft a Magic capsule and right-click a Grotesque Steve to capture him inside.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.fill_bucket_wit: Get swallowed by a Grotesque Steve into the Stomach and right-click a Bbb pool with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.find_mysterybox: Find a Mystery box in the Grotesque Mansion, or rename a Grotesque Steve to 'Mystery' and kill him.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.given_on_first_: Join the world for the first time to receive it.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.kill_grotesque_: Right-click a Grotesque Steve while holding Protein to turn him into Grotesque Prime, then kill him.
Find a Grotesque Steve mound in plains, forest, birch forest, taiga or savanna and kill it.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.loot_bundle_ran: Right-click Loot bundles from quest rewards in hand; each gives random items, possibly these.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.loot_mansion_co: Kill a Grotesque Steve to unlock the Grotesque Mansion, then search its containers for the items.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.open_mailbox: Hold a Mail box and right-click to open it; it drops one random item.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.open_mysterybox: Hold a Mystery box and right-click to open it; it drops either a Magnet or a Bubble mover.
ll8.info.grotesque_steve.take_bust_from_: Right-click the Prime Statue that forms after killing Grotesque Prime to get the Prime statue bust.
ll8.info.herbalbrews.from_dried_green: Craft a Dried Green Tea Leaf Block, place it and wait for it to dry.
ll8.info.herbalbrews.from_green: Craft a Green Tea Leaf Block, place it and wait for it to dry.
ll8.info.herbalbrews.from_mixed: Craft a Mixed Tea Leaf Block, place it and wait for it to dry.
ll8.info.ic2cre.ash_from_solid_fuel_fire: Burn furnace fuel in a Solid Fuel Firebox and collect the Ashes it sometimes leaves behind.
ll8.info.ic2cre.bake_coal_in_coke_kiln: Build a Coke Kiln multiblock from Refractory Bricks and drop Coal into the top hatch to bake it.
ll8.info.ic2cre.break_crop_for_seed_bag: Break a grown plant on Crop Sticks to get a Crop Seed Bag with its genes and stats.
ll8.info.ic2cre.fill_bucket_in_fluid_can: Load the Fluid Canner with liquid and put an empty bucket in the fill slot.
ll8.info.ic2cre.harvest_crossbred_crop: Cross two grown crops with a Crop Stick between them, then right-click to harvest the hybrid.
ll8.info.ic2cre.liquid_heat_exchanger_co: Feed hot fluid into the Liquid Heat Exchanger's hot side and put an empty bucket in the cold slot.
ll8.info.ic2cre.reactor_hot_coolant_slot: Build a 5x5x5 Reactor Pressure Vessel shell around the Nuclear Reactor, then load coolant and buckets.
ll8.info.ic2cre.solar_distiller_output_s: Put a Water Bucket in the Solar Distiller's water slot and an empty bucket below.
ll8.info.ic2cre.tap_booze_barrel_with_mu: Right-click a Booze Barrel with a Treetap to tap it, then use a Stone Mug to collect the brew.
ll8.info.iceandfire.capture_dragon_with_: Craft a Dragon Horn, tame a dragon, then right-click it with the Horn.
ll8.info.iceandfire.catch_pixie_in_jar: Craft a Jar, find a Pixie in a Flower Forest, then right-click it.
ll8.info.iceandfire.kill_troll_for_weapo: Kill a Troll to get its weapon.
ll8.info.iceandfire.silk_touch_stone_sta: Hit a Stone Statue with a Silk Touch pickaxe until it breaks.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.acetaldehy: Refine Ethanol with Silver Plate or Petroleum Gas with Constantan Plate in Refinery; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.biodiesel: Refine Plant Oil and Ethanol with Nitrate Dust in Refinery; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.circuit_ta: Power Engineer's Circuit Workbench, load Circuit Backplane, Vacuum Tubes and Copper Wire, pick operator.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.creosote: Bake Coal in a Coke Oven; pipe Creosote Oil into a tank, then right-click it with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.ethanol: Ferment crops in an Industrial Fermenter, pipe Ethanol into a tank, and right-click the tank with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.fill_potio: Brew potion fluid in a Mixer, pipe it into a Wooden Barrel or Fluid Tank, then right-click with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.herbicide: Mix Ethanol, Sulfur Dust, and Copper Dust in a Mixer, pipe into a tank, and right-click the tank with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.high_cetan: Refine Biodiesel with liquid Potion of Strength made in Mixer in Refinery; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.outfitter_: Trade with Outfitter for Emeralds, or craft one bag of the next rarity level into two of this rarity.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.phenolic_r: Refine Acetaldehyde with Creosote Oil in Refinery; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersiveengineering.plantoil: Squeeze seeds in an Industrial Squeezer, pipe Plant Oil into a tank, then right-click it with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.benzol: Distill Kerosene in Distillation Tower; pipe Benzol to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.crusher_petc: Crush Petcoke in an Immersive Engineering Crusher.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.distillation: Distill Crude Oil in Distillation Tower; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.fill_from_ta: Find oil with a Seismic Survey Tool, build a Derrick, pump into a tank, then right-click it with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.gasoline: Refine Naphtha with Benzol in Refinery; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.hydrotreater: Process Sulfurized Diesel with water in High-Pressure Refinery Unit; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.light_with_f: Hold unlit Molotov in main hand, Flint and Steel in off hand, right-click for 1 second.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.napalm: Mix Aluminum Dust into Gasoline in Mixer; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.petroleum_ga: Process Naphtha with water in High-Pressure Refinery Unit; pipe to tank, fill Bucket.
ll8.info.immersivepetroleum.seismic_surv: Place a Seismic Survey Tool, load with Buckshot Cartridge, then right-click with empty hand.
ll8.info.industrialforegoing.fill_bucket: Fill an empty Bucket at the machine tank: drop it in the bucket slot or right-click the tank gauge.
ll8.info.industrialforegoing.ore_meat_ch: Make Raw Ore Meat in a Washing Factory with Liquid Meat and raw ore, then ferment it in a Fermentation Station.
ll8.info.integrateddynamics.fill_bucket_: Squeeze Menril Log in powered Mechanical Squeezer, then right-click with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.integrateddynamics.liquid_choru: Squeeze Popped Chorus Fruit in powered Mechanical Squeezer, then right-click with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.ironfurnaces.explode_million_fu: Place a Rainbow Furnace and blow it up with TNT, a Creeper or any other explosion.
ll8.info.irons_jewelry.chest_loot_and_je: Find it in structure chests or buy it from a Jeweler villager for Emeralds.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.energized_core: Right-click a Lightning Rod with Energized Core during a thunderstorm to get the staff.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.kill_magehunte: Slay the Magehunter Vindicator on Evoker Fort tower for a rare Magehunter sword drop.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.kill_necromanc: Kill Necromancers for the Tarnished Crown they wear; they spawn at night and in Catacombs.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.take_lectern_b: Take the book from a lectern inside the Evoker Fort tower or Pyromancer Tower dungeons.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.trade_cryomanc: Loot 4 Fire Ale from Pyromancer Tower and trade them to the Cryomancer in Mountain Tower.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.trade_fort_mag: Trade an untranslated Archevoker's Logbook and 64 Emeralds to the fort magician.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.trade_priest_o: Trade a translated Archevoker's Logbook to the Priest in a village.
ll8.info.irons_spellbooks.trade_wanderin: Trade with a wandering trader for rare items (~112 Emeralds).
ll8.info.justdirethings.blaze_ember: Throw Blaze Ember into Polymorphic Fluid source block, then collect the resulting fuel with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.eclipse_ember: Throw Eclipse Ember into Voidflame Fuel source block, then collect the resulting fuel with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.fill_from_experi: Craft an Experience Holder, fill it with experience, then right-click it with an empty bucket to get XP Fluid.
ll8.info.justdirethings.goo_converts_bud: Place Shadowpulse Goo next to Budding Amethyst or Time Crystal Block, revive with Sculk and wait 4 minutes.
ll8.info.justdirethings.polymorphic: Throw a Polymorphic Catalyst into a water source block and collect the fluid with a bucket.

ll8.info.justdirethings.t3: Put VoidShimmer Goo by Unrefined Voidflame Fuel source block, revive with Ender Pearl or Chorus Fruit, wait 2m, bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.t4: Place Shadowpulse Goo at Unrefined Eclipse Ember Fuel source, revive with Sculk, wait 2 min, bucket it.
ll8.info.justdirethings.till_dirt_eclips: Right-click dirt with an Eclipse Alloy Hoe to create Shadowpulse Soil.
ll8.info.justdirethings.unstable_portal: Throw Portal Fluid Catalyst into Polymorphic Fluid and collect with a bucket.
ll8.info.justdirethings.voidflame: Throw Voidflame Coal into Blaze Ember Fuel source block, then collect the resulting fuel with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.livingthings.bucket_seahorse: Right-click a live Seahorse in water with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.livingthings.take_from_ostrich_: Breed Ostriches: the pregnant one lays an egg in an Ostrich Nest; right-click the nest with an empty hand.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.block_with_strength: Strengthen a Shield, gain Immunity/Damage Exchange, wear 15+ armor, collect souls, then block a hit.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.blood_circle_on_clo: Draw a blood circle on Spell Cloth with a Dagger and Powdered Catalysts.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.bucket_the_lake: Right-click a Murky Water source block with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.kill_pet_with_calib: Kill your tamed wolf with Caliburn in your main hand.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.lightning_on_streng: Strengthen a stick in your off-hand, then get struck by lightning during a thunderstorm.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.longshot_with_stren: Strengthen a Bow with a Scroll, then shoot a target at least 200 blocks away.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.strengthened_book_o: Strengthen a written book with a Scroll, then right-click an empty Lectern with it.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.strengthened_sword_: Strengthen a sword, stand in the Ender Dragon's breath cloud, then right-click.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.throw_sword_in_lake: Create a Power Consolidation circle, fill it with Murky Water, throw an enchanted sword into it.
ll8.info.mahoutsukai.use_scroll_to_summo: Hold the scroll and right-click to summon the weapon and spend it.
ll8.info.malum.soul_binding_brazier: Craft a Soulbinding Brazier, add ingredients and spirits, right-click with Ether, and sacrifice creatures.
ll8.info.malum.thrown_weapon_placeholder: Hold a Rebound-enchanted scythe or the Sundering Anchor and right-click to throw it.
ll8.info.malum.weeping_well_rejection: Find a Weeping Well underground in the Overworld and jump into its liquid pool.
ll8.info.mcwholidays.toggle_ghost: Craft a Ghost (white wool + white carpets), place it and right-click once for Happy Ghost, again for Haunting Ghost.
ll8.info.mcwholidays.toggle_sleeping_bat: Craft a Sleeping Bat (brown wool + brown carpets), place it and right-click to turn it into an Awakened Bat.
ll8.info.mcwholidays.toggle_stocking_pai: Place a single stocking of the same colour, then right-click it with an empty hand to turn it into a pair.
ll8.info.mekanism.electric_pump_filter: Install a Filter Upgrade in an Electric Pump over water, power it and place a bucket in its container slot.

ll8.info.mekanism.rotary_condense_to_buc: Pipe the chemical into a powered Rotary Condensentrator and put an empty Bucket in its top right slot.
ll8.info.mekanism.thermal_evaporation_pl: Build a Thermal Evaporation Plant, fill it with water and place an empty bucket in the controller's output slot.
ll8.info.mekanismgenerators.fill_from_ro: Feed Deuterium, Tritium or D-T Fuel to a powered Rotary Condensentrator, put empty Bucket in its top right slot.
ll8.info.minecolonies.bee_queen_christma: Dec 24-25 (real date), give the Bee Queen in the Bumblezone Cookies for a rare Santa Hat reward.
ll8.info.minecolonies.blacksmith_assista: Research 'Professional Assistant' at the University, then request the hammer at a Postbox.
ll8.info.minecolonies.blacksmith_plate_a: Build a Blacksmith's Hut, hire a Blacksmith, upgrade to level 4, research 'Plate Armor', then request at a Postbox.
ll8.info.minecolonies.hut_gui_obtain_too: Right-click a hut block, switch to 'Selection Tools', then click 'Obtain Tool'.
ll8.info.minecolonies.magicpotion_from_a: Research 'Panoramix' at the University, then request Magic Potion at a Postbox.
ll8.info.minecolonies.mistletoe_harveste: Give the Alchemist Shears and place the Alchemist Tower; the Alchemist will harvest Mistletoe from leaf blocks.
ll8.info.minecolonies.request_from_baker: Build a Bakery and hire a Baker, then request bread at a Postbox; level requirements vary by recipe.
ll8.info.minecolonies.request_from_chef: Build a Chef's Kitchen, hire a Chef, upgrade to level 4, then request dishes at a Postbox.
ll8.info.minecolonies.scrolls_from_encha: Build an Enchanter's Tower, hire an Enchanter, then request the scroll at a Postbox.
ll8.info.minecolonies.sifter_mesh_from_c: Request the mesh at a Postbox once your Sifter reaches the required level; the worker will craft it.
ll8.info.minecolonies.townhall_permissio: Right-click your Town Hall, open 'Permissions', find 'Free for Interaction', then click the scepter icon.
ll8.info.mob_grinding_utils.fill_bucket_: Stand on an XP Drain Singularity Tank to drain your experience into it, then right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.mobflowutilities.drop_from_boss: Kill an Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden or Elder Guardian to guarantee Life Catalyst drops.
ll8.info.mobflowutilities.drop_from_mobs: Kill passive mobs or raid village chests for Glimmer Sprout; kill hostile mobs or raid fortress chests for Gloom Spore.
ll8.info.mobflowutilities.sample_mob_wit: Shift-right-click a mob that has a spawn egg while holding an Empty Gene Vial.

Mix Acrylic Acid with Chromium Tiny Dust or Lead Tiny Dust in a Chemical Reactor; click output with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.attune: Right-click an AE2 P2P Tunnel placed on ME Cable with a Superconductor Cable to attune it.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.biodie: Combine Raw Biodiesel and Steam in a Chemical Reactor; click output with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.booste: Mix Diesel or Biodiesel with Diethyl Ether in an Electric Mixer; click output slot with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.caprol: React Benzene, Hydrogen, and 4 Nickel Tiny Dust in a Chemical Reactor; click output slot with empty Bucket.

Centrifuge Platinum Sulfuric Solution to purify it; click output slot with empty Bucket.

ll8.info.modern_industrialization.chromi: Put Chromium Crushed Dust and Hydrochloric Acid into a Chemical Reactor; click output with empty Bucket.

ll8.info.modern_industrialization.diesel: Mix 1000 mB Heavy Fuel and 5000 mB Light Fuel in an Electric Mixer; click output slot with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.diethy: Combine Ethanol and Acrylic Acid in a Chemical Reactor; click output with an empty Bucket.

Distill Crude Oil in a Distillery; left-click its output fluid slot with an empty Bucket.
Distill Shale Oil, not Crude Oil, in a Distillery; left-click its output fluid slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.drill_: Put Aluminum Drill (Crude Oil) or Stainless Steel Drill (Shale Oil) in a powered Oil Drilling Rig's input hatch.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.ethano: React Ethylene, Water and Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Reactor; click output with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.freeze: Feed Argon and Helium into a powered Vacuum Freezer; bucket from fluid output hatch.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.fusion: Feed Deuterium with Deuterium or Tritium into a powered Fusion Reactor; bucket from fluid output hatch.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.heavy_: Boil Heavy Water in a Large Steam Boiler; open its fluid output hatch and click slot with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.helium: Put Monazite Dust or Uranium Dust into a Centrifuge; click Helium output with empty Bucket.
Put Helium into a Centrifuge; click Helium 3 output with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.hydroc: Combine Hydrogen and Chlorine in a Chemical Reactor; click output with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.hydrot: Feed Sulfuric Heavy/Light Fuel or Sulfuric Naphtha with Hydrogen into a Chemical Reactor; bucket output.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.liquid: Put Liquid Air into a Centrifuge to get Nitrogen and Argon; click output with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.lubric: Mix Redstone Dust with Creosote in a Bronze, Steel or Electric Mixer; click the output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.mangan: Put Manganese Crushed Dust and 9000 mB Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Reactor; click the output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.melt: Melt Redstone Dust or Soldering Alloy Dust in an Electric Blast Furnace; click fluid output hatch with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.nylon: React Caprolactam with 1 Chromium Tiny Dust or 4 Lead Tiny Dust in Chemical Reactor; click output with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.platin: Put Raw Platinum and 9000 mB Sulfuric Acid in a Chemical Reactor; click the output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.polyet: React Ethylene with 1 Chromium Tiny Dust or 4 Lead Tiny Dust in a Chemical Reactor; click output with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.polyvi: React Vinyl Chloride with 1 Chromium Tiny Dust or 4 Lead Tiny Dust in Chemical Reactor; click output with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.pressu: Feed Water, Heavy Water, Steam or Heavy Water Steam into a powered Pressurizer; bucket from fluid output hatch.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.raw_bi: React Plant Oil, Ethanol and Sodium Hydroxide in a Chemical Reactor; click the output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.raw_sy: Mix Carbon Dust or Coke Dust with Water in a Bronze, Steel or Electric Mixer; click output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.sodium: React Sodium Dust with Oxygen and Hydrogen in a Chemical Reactor; click the output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.steam_: Run Light Fuel, Heavy Fuel or Naphtha with Steam in a Chemical Reactor; click output slot with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.styren: React Ethylbenzene, Steam and Iron Dust in a Chemical Reactor; click the Styrene output slot with an empty Bucket.
Combine Styrene and Butadiene in a Chemical Reactor; click the output slot with an empty Bucket.
React Styrene-Butadiene with 1 Chromium or 4 Lead Tiny Dust in a Chemical Reactor; click output with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.sugar_: Mix Sugar with Water in a Bronze, Steel or Electric Mixer; left-click its output fluid slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.sulfur: Put Sulfur Dust, Oxygen and Water in a Chemical Reactor; left-click its output fluid slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.synthe: Run Raw Synthetic Oil through a Steam or Electric Blast Furnace; left-click its Fluid Output Hatch slot with a Bucket.
Mix Sulfur Dust with 1000 mB Synthetic Oil in Steel or Electric Mixer; click output slot with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.uu_mat: Put a Singularity in an Electrolyzer with an Advanced Upgrade; left-click its output with a Bucket at 1000 mB.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.vinyl_: Put Acetylene and Hydrochloric Acid in a Chemical Reactor; left-click its output fluid slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.modern_industrialization.water: Electrolyze Water in an Electrolyzer; click the Hydrogen or Oxygen output slot with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.mynethersdelight.ham: Right-click a Stuffed Hoglin (ears cut, snout removed, 8–5 servings) with an empty Bowl.

ll8.info.mynethersdelight.snout: Place a Stuffed Hoglin, cut both ears with a knife, then right-click with an empty Bowl when 9 servings remain.
ll8.info.mysticalagradditions.melt_in_pm: Melt matching Mystical Agriculture essence in a Productive Metalworks foundry and right-click the drain with a bucket.
ll8.info.mythsandlegends.assemble_in_sto: In a Stone Sanctum Table, put a Cursed Core in the core slot and Gargoyle parts in all five other slots.
ll8.info.naturalist.catch_with_capture_n: Hold a Capture Net and right-click a live butterfly, caterpillar, crab, snail or Desert Scorpion.
ll8.info.naturalist.drop_from_fox_holdin: Kill a fox carrying this disc in its mouth; the disc always drops.
ll8.info.naturalist.drop_when_boar_kills: Let an angry boar land the killing blow on a player; the disc drops with a 10% chance.
ll8.info.naturalist.empty_bucket_on_duck: Right-click a duckling with an empty Bucket to capture it.
ll8.info.naturalist.fill_bucket_from_wat: Right-click a water mob with a Water Bucket to capture it.
ll8.info.naturalist.tame_then_catch_with: Tame hedgehogs with Sweet/Glow Berries, rats with Bread, then right-click holding a Capture Net.
ll8.info.neovitae.athanor_ore_processing: Run ore through the Athanor with Cutting Fluid and Resonator to produce Dust.
ll8.info.neovitae.kill_with_sentient_or_: Kill a hostile mob with a Sentient Weapon or throw an Iron Throwing Dagger first.
ll8.info.neovitae.syringe_dagger_kill: Throw a Syringe Throwing Dagger at a mob and let the dagger land the killing blow.
ll8.info.netherdepthsupgrade.scoop_live_: Right-click a live lava fish with a Lava Bucket.
ll8.info.netherman.break_nether_seal: Find a Nether Geyser structure underground and break three Nether Seal blocks with a stone pickaxe.
ll8.info.netherman.solve_maze_puzzle: Solve one of the three puzzles inside the Azazel Maze to earn the Samson Key.
ll8.info.netherman.surrender_to_azazel: Defeat Azazel and click the surrender icon on the final screen.
ll8.info.netherman.trade_believer_villag: Find a Believer House and buy the Cult of Azazel Guidebook from the Believer Villager.
ll8.info.netherman.transform_azazel_spea: Hold the Azazel Spear and press Shift + right-click to transform it into Judicus.
ll8.info.occultism.beaver_familiar_snack: Right-click an upgraded Beaver Familiar with an empty hand.
ll8.info.occultism.crush_echo_marid_tier: Summon a Marid Crusher and drop an Echo Shard beside it.
ll8.info.occultism.crush_ice_djinni_tier: Summon a Djinni Crusher and toss ice beside it.
ll8.info.occultism.crush_shared_dust_tag: This Occultism dust variant is unobtainable in this pack.
ll8.info.occultism.crush_with_foliot_cru: Summon a Foliot Crusher and toss the source block beside it.
ll8.info.occultism.demonic_partner_honey: Right-click your Demonic Husband or Wife with Cursed Honey.
ll8.info.occultism.ritual_craft_gem: Craft the gem via ritual on a Golden Sacrificial Bowl.
ll8.info.occultism.ritual_into_upside_do: Run any non-producing ritual with an inverted Sacrificial Bowl above the golden one.
ll8.info.oceansdelight.serve_feast_with_: Cook Guardian Soup in a Cooking Pot, place the soup block, then right-click it with an empty Bowl.
ll8.info.oritech.bucket_from_oil_spring: Find a crude oil spring and right-click its oil source block with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.centrifuge: With a Fluid Addon on a Centrifuge, process Quartz Dust with Light Naphtha; right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.centrifuge_mineral_slur: With a Fluid Addon on a Centrifuge, process an ore clump with Sulfuric Acid; right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.fill_from_steam_boiler: Pump Lava into a Refinery; right-click the Refinery with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.melt_in_metalworks_foun: Melt the matching Oritech material in a Productive Metalworks foundry; bucket it from a Foundry Drain.
ll8.info.oritech.refinery: Pump Crude Oil into a Refinery; right-click the Refinery with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.oritech.refinery_diesel: Put Heavy Oil and Sand into a Refinery; right-click the Refinery with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.otakomod_anime_characters.conve: Kill Asta, then right-click the Grimoire.
ll8.info.otakomod_anime_characters.kill_: Kill the Inazuma Eleven footballer wearing the uniform.
Kill the named character for the full outfit.
Kill the character, then its stronger form.
ll8.info.otakomod_anime_characters.rare_: Defeat the weapon's bearer for a rare drop.
ll8.info.packagedauto.made_in_fluid_pack: Put a Fluid Package Filler next to a tank with a filled container as template, give it power and Redstone signal
ll8.info.packagedauto.made_in_packager: Encode a recipe onto Package Recipe Holder in Package Recipe Encoder, put it in powered Packager, feed ingredients
ll8.info.pastel.bucket_an_eraser: Right-click a living Eraser with an empty Bucket to catch it.
ll8.info.pastel.catch_shooting_star: Run into falling stars at night to catch them, or pick them up from the ground.
ll8.info.pastel.grow_fluix_in_crystallar: Grow Fluix Cluster in a Crystallarieum with Fluix Dust, yellow ink, and a catalyst.
ll8.info.pastel.mine_budding_with_resona: Mine Budding Moonstone with a pickaxe enchanted with Resonance.
ll8.info.pastel.socket_and_open_locket: Socket a Moonstone Core into the Locket via Fusion Shrine, then open it.
ll8.info.pastel.take_from_manor_item_bow: Right-click the Enlightenment Item Bowl while under the Fatal Slumber effect.
ll8.info.pastel.take_from_manxi_statue: Right-click the Stargazer Manxi statue with an empty hand to take the handbook.
ll8.info.pastel.till_with_hoe: Right-click Shale Clay or Slush in the Deeper Down with a Hoe to till them.
ll8.info.pastel.titration_barrel_bulb_wi: Ferment flower bulbs and petals with water in a Titration Barrel to brew Wines.
ll8.info.pastel.titration_barrel_cheong: Ferment eight fruits and 16 Sugar with water in a Titration Barrel to make Cheong.
ll8.info.pastel.titration_barrel_suspici: Ferment four small flowers with water in a Titration Barrel to make a Brew.
ll8.info.piglinproliferation.bastion_che: Loot some bastion chests or kill Piglin Brutes; they can drop Bucklers.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.brew_yeast_cultu: Put a mushroom and Water in Thermopneumatic Processing Plant at 303-333K, then right-click it with empty Bucket
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.ethanol: Add Sugar to Yeast Culture in a Thermopneumatic Processing Plant at 303-333K; right-click it with a Bucket.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.fill_from_fluid_: Mix Vegetable Oil and Ethanol in Fluid Mixer at 2 bar, then right-click mixer with empty Bucket
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.fill_from_refine: Heat Refinery Controller with 4 Refinery Outputs to 373K, pump Crude Oil, right-click output with empty Bucket
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.lubricant: Process Diesel or Biodiesel with Redstone Dust in Thermopneumatic Processing Plant at 373K+, right-click it with Bucket
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.scoop_oil_lake: Find a Crude Oil lake and right-click its source block with an empty bucket, or buy oil through Amadron Tablet.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.store_player_xp: Right-click with a Memory Stick to store XP, then empty it into a Small Fluid Tank and fill a bucket there.
ll8.info.pneumaticcraft.vegetable_oil: Process seeds or crops in Thermopneumatic Processing Plant at 2 bar, then right-click it with empty Bucket
ll8.info.potionbundles.craft_special_bun: Put 3 identical potions and 1 String into a crafting grid
ll8.info.powah.binding_card_on_enderman: Hold a Binding Card and right-click an Enderman or Endermite; it becomes Binding Card (Dimensional).
ll8.info.productivebees.beekeeper_master: Make a Beekeeper with Advanced Oak Beehive, trade to Master and buy random bee spawn egg
ll8.info.productivebees.bottle_bee_with_: Use a Bottler and Piston to crush a live bee into a bottle.
ll8.info.productivebees.centrifuge_squas: Put the Squashed Bee Material in a Centrifuge to extract Gene Samples.
ll8.info.productivebees.incubate_type_ge: Incubate an egg with a Type Gene Sample and Honey Treat in an Incubator.
ll8.info.productivemetalworks.alloy: Melt the alloy's ingredients together in a fuelled Foundry, then right-click a Foundry Drain with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.productivemetalworks.fill_bucke: Melt raw meat in your Foundry, then right-click a Foundry Drain with an empty bucket to collect it.
ll8.info.productivemetalworks.melt_in_fo: Melt the matching material in the Foundry, then right-click the Foundry Drain with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.productivemetalworks.obsidian: Right-click Foundry Drain with Water Bucket and two Lava Buckets or melt Obsidian then click with empty Bucket
ll8.info.productivetrees.strip_cork_oak_: Strip a Cork Oak Log by right-clicking it with an axe or strip it in a Stripper
ll8.info.psi.program_bullet_at_spell_pro: Build a compiling spell in a Spell Programmer, right-click with a matching blank bullet.
ll8.info.psi.program_flash_ring: Sneak-right-click with a Flash Ring to write a spell or sneak-right-click a Spell Programmer with a built spell
ll8.info.quark.bucket_the_crab: Find a Crab on a Beach and right-click it with a Water Bucket.
ll8.info.quark.end_city_treasure: Loot treasure chests in End Cities.
ll8.info.quark.fill_bottle_in_cloud_laye: At Y 191–196, right-click with Glass Bottle for Cloud in a Bottle, place it.
ll8.info.quark.parrot_lays_egg: Tame a Parrot and feed it Beetroot Seeds.
ll8.info.quark.shear_vine_in_place: Right-click Vines with Shears to replace them with Cut Vines.
ll8.info.quark.spider_killed_by_skeleton: Make a Skeleton kill a Spider to obtain an Ambience Disc.
ll8.info.reanimal.bird_lays_egg_over_tim: Keep an adult bird of the matching species nearby; it lays eggs every 5–10 minutes.
ll8.info.refurbished_furniture.send_via_: Put items into a Post Box, select a recipient mailbox and press Send; items pack into a Package in the target mailbox.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_any: Open loot chests in any dimension.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_bastion: Find a bastion remnant in the Nether and open its chests.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_end: Open any chest in The End or a stronghold chest in the Overworld.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_forest_biome: Open generated loot chests in forest or jungle biomes, such as woodland mansions and jungle temples.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_nether: Open chests in the Nether, or Nether fortress and ruined portal chests in any dimension.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_overworld_any: Open any loot chest in the Overworld.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_village: Open loot chests in villages or pillager outposts.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_village_or_ca: Open loot chests in villages, pillager outposts, or cave biomes.
ll8.info.relics.chest_loot_water_biome: Open generated loot chests in ocean, beach or river biomes, such as shipwrecks and ocean ruins.
ll8.info.relics.drop_from_dead_pet: Wear a Hunting Belt, level its Pack ability until pet revival unlocks, then let one of your own tamed pets die.
ll8.info.reliquary.boil_in_apothecary_ca: Boil Potion Essence and Nether Wart in a water-filled Apothecary Cauldron; fill a Condensed Potion Vial.
ll8.info.reliquary.grind_in_apothecary_m: Put 2–3 ingredients sharing effect in Apothecary Mortar, right-click five times empty-handed.
ll8.info.reliquified_ars_nouveau.kill_mi: Kill a Mimic in underground Artifacts campsites or open chests in magic biomes and structures.
ll8.info.reliquified_irons_spells_and_sp: Explore Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks structures and open every chest, cask, vault and pot you find.
Right-click a chest with unwanted relics using Mimi Dust, kill the Mimic, and collect random relics.
ll8.info.rftoolsdim.craft_in_dimlet_work: Assemble in a Dimlet Workbench with a Knowledge Holder next to it, or find in RFTools dimension chests.
ll8.info.rftoolspower.blazing_agitator: Put Blaze Rods into a powered Blazing Agitator; over time they turn into Blazing Rods you can take out.
ll8.info.rftoolsstorage.install_storage_: Sneak-right-click a Tablet (empty) and insert a Storage Control Screen Module; it becomes Tablet (scanner).
ll8.info.rftoolsutility.install_module_i: Shift-right-click Tablet (empty), insert Redstone Module for redstone or Screen Link for screen.
ll8.info.ribbits.ribbit_merchant_trade: Find a Ribbit village in a swamp and trade with the Merchant Ribbit; one offer is a Maraca for Amethyst Shards.
ll8.info.rootsclassic.imbue_stick_with_s: Make Spell Powder in Mortar with Pestle, then put Powder and stick in Imbuer.
ll8.info.rusticdelight.plant_in_flower_p: Collect the matching wild plant with Shears, then right-click an empty Flower Pot while holding it.
ll8.info.securitycraft.brew_in_brewing_s: In a Brewing Stand, brew Potion of Harming over Water Buckets, or Potion of Healing over Lava Buckets.
ll8.info.securitycraft.charge_taser_with: Hold a Taser with Redstone Dust in your inventory, then sneak and right-click to charge it.
ll8.info.securitycraft.craft_from_staine: Craft a Lens with any dye, or three reinforced stained glass panes of one colour in zigzag: right, left, right.
ll8.info.sfm.anvil_on_iron_block: Drop an Anvil onto an Enchanted Book, Written Book, Map or Factory Manager Program Disk on a Block of Iron.
ll8.info.sgearmetalworks.fill_bucket_fro: Melt Silent Gems in a Productive Metalworks Foundry; at 1000 mb, right-click the Foundry Drain with an empty bucket.
Heat Silent Gear metal in Productive Foundry at 1000°C, then right-click Foundry Drain with bucket at 1000 mb.
Alloy molten heavy core and rare metals in Productive Foundry, then right-click Drain with bucket at 1000 mb.
ll8.info.sgjourney.april_fools_jaffa_bur: Own a working Stargate on April 1st and kill Jaffa for burgers.
ll8.info.sgjourney.archeologist_trade_sy: Buy symbols from an Archeologist or mine them from Cartouche Monuments.
ll8.info.sgjourney.assemble_classic_star: Craft the components and stack them as a Stargate ring, then right-click the base.
ll8.info.sgjourney.break_generated_starg: Break any block of a generated Stargate to pick it up as one item.
ll8.info.sgjourney.drop_from_abydos_jaff: Dial a Stargate to Abydos, find a Goa'uld Desert Pyramid and kill the Jaffa inside; they sometimes drop it.
ll8.info.sgjourney.mine_cartouche: Mine a Cartouche block with a stone pickaxe or better.
ll8.info.sgjourney.tollan_upgrade_crysta: Craft an Upgrade Crystal in a Crystallizer and right-click a placed Classic Stargate.
ll8.info.sgjourney.villager_map_trade: Buy a Map to Chappa'ai from a Master Archeologist.
ll8.info.shrink.bottle_shrunk_mob: Shrink a mob with a Personal Shrinking Device, then right-click it with an empty Glass Bottle.
ll8.info.silentgear.made_in_paint_mixer: Put dyes into a Paint Mixer; adding Slimeballs to the dyes makes more Paint.
ll8.info.silentgems.rabbit_drops_coffee: Keep rabbits around; each drops a Cup of Coffee over time that you can pick up.
ll8.info.snowyspirit.runtime_generated_r: At a Crafting Table: two Birch Planks then a Stick in one row, three Sticks in the row directly below.
ll8.info.sophisticatedcore.fill_bucket_f: Put Tank and Experience Pump Upgrades in a Backpack, place empty Bucket in Output slot, XP will pump into tank.
ll8.info.spelunkers_charm.wandering_trad: Find a Wandering Trader and buy a Mining Helmet from its rare trade slot for 25 Emeralds.
ll8.info.spider_overhaul.bottle_jungle_s: Kill a Jungle Spider in a jungle biome, then right-click its pollen puddle with a Glass Bottle.
ll8.info.starbunclemania.wixie_charm_on_: Sneak right-click a Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot or Cutting Board with a Wixie Charm.
Right-click a Furnace, Stonecutter, or Starbunclemania Fluid Jar with a Wixie Charm.
ll8.info.starcatcher.bucket_bait_slot: Put an Empty Bucket as bait in your Rod and catch a fish to store it.
ll8.info.starcatcher.fish_air: Craft a Cloud Bobber, equip your Rod with it, then cast off a high ledge.
ll8.info.starcatcher.fish_lava: Equip your Rod with an Amethyst Hook or Netherite upgrade, then cast into lava.
ll8.info.starcatcher.fish_up_bottle: Catch rare and epic fish to unlock rare bottles, then fish for them.
ll8.info.starcatcher.fish_water: Slot Iron Hook, Bobber and bait into a Starcatcher Rod via Tackle Box, then cast.
ll8.info.starcatcher.open_bottle: Right-click a Message in a Bottle to break it and read the letter.
ll8.info.stellaris.bucket_from_oil_lake_: Right-click an oil source block with an empty bucket, or place one in a Pumpjack's bucket slot.
ll8.info.stellaris.diesel_from_fuel_refi: Put an empty Bucket in the diesel slot of a powered Fuel Refinery fed with Oil.
ll8.info.stellaris.hydrogen_from_water_s: Put an empty Bucket in the hydrogen slot of a powered Water Separator fed with Water.
ll8.info.stellaris.pick_from_moon_vines: Go to the Moon Caves biome on the Moon and right-click a glowing vine segment with berries to pick a Moon Berry.
ll8.info.stevescarts.cart_assembler: Place a Cart Assembler, insert a hull and modules, add fuel, start assembly.
ll8.info.supplementaries.cannonball_cree: Kill a Creeper with a Cannon loaded with Gunpowder and a Cannonball.
ll8.info.supplementaries.cartographer_tr: Buy the Adventurer Map from a Cartographer villager at Apprentice level.
ll8.info.supplementaries.dye_present: Craft a plain Present from paper, then dye it by crafting with any dye.
ll8.info.supplementaries.dye_trapped_pre: Make a Trapped Present from paper and a Tripwire Hook, then dye it with any dye.
ll8.info.supplementaries.jar_on_tiny_pot: Sneak-right-click a placed Tiny Potato with an empty Jar to get Tater in a Jar.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.chop_on_cutting: Place a Cutting Board, right-click it with a raw ingredient and Cleaver Knife to chop it.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.cook_in_rice_co: Place a Rice Cooker, fill it with Rice, Water, and fuel, then activate it to cook the rice.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.kill_any_fish: Kill fish like Cod, Salmon, Tuna, or Shrimp to get fillets and Tobiko roe.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.pick_ripe_avoca: Right-click a ripe Avocado leaf block on a tree with an empty hand to pick the fruit.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.piston_press_dr: Power a Piston to crush a Dried Kelp Block into Nori Sheets between it and an Iron Block.

ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_gunkan: Place a Gunkan Roller with Nori Sheet, Cooked Rice, and a topping, then left-click it four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_maki: Place a Roller with Nori Sheet, Cooked Rice, and filling, set weights and left-click it four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_nigiri: Place a Nigiri Roller with Nori Sheet, Cooked Rice, and a topping, then left-click it four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_onigiri: Place an Onigiri Roller with Nori Sheet and Cooked Rice, then left-click it about four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.roll_temaki: Place a Temaki Roller with Nori Sheet, Cooked Rice, Avocado, and filling, then left-click it four times.
ll8.info.sushigocrafting.scoop_fish_with: Right-click a Tuna or Shrimp in an ocean with a Water Bucket to scoop it up.
ll8.info.synergy.bucket_from_foundry_or_: Right-click a Foundry or Electric Melter with an empty bucket to collect molten material.
ll8.info.synergy.extractor_press: Power an Extractor with FE, feed it Ironberries or Oil, collect with a bucket.
ll8.info.synergy.honey_from_crushing_tub: Jump on a Crushing Tub filled with honeycombs, then right-click with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.synergy.steam_via_fluid_tank: Heat a Steam Boiler with water, transfer steam to a Fluid Tank, collect with a bucket.

ll8.info.thavma.click_book_entry: Open the Elements of Thavma book, left-click an unlearned entry whose previous entries are all learned.

ll8.info.thavma.wand_on_bookshelf: Craft any Thavma wand and right-click a Bookshelf with it.
ll8.info.the_backwoods.fade_in_loss_inve: Carry an Apple, Beetroot, Dried Kelp, Golden Apple or Enchanted Golden Apple in the Loss dimension.
ll8.info.the_bumblezone.music_disc_river: Fish in the Bumblezone, buy from a Wandering Trader, or give the Bee Queen a Honey Block for a random reward.
ll8.info.the_bumblezone.music_disc_sourc: Fish in the Bumblezone, take from Item Frames in Dance Floor or Gazebuzz Cluster, or buy from Wandering Trader.
ll8.info.touhou_little_maid.camera_shot_: Hold Aya's Camera in your main hand and right-click one of your own maids that is awake.
ll8.info.touhou_little_maid.loot_bundle_: Open a Loot bundle (quest reward, mob drop or craft from 9 fragments) for random items.
ll8.info.touhou_little_maid.roast_tiny_s: Chisel in main hand, Photo in off hand, right-click a lone Clay block, keep Fire below until it becomes a Garage Kit.
ll8.info.touhou_little_maid_spell.hidden: Craft Wind Seeking Bell at Altar, use in Overworld for Retreat, then use for Hidden Retreat, barrel in base.
ll8.info.tropicraft.bucket_tropical_fish: Hold a Water Bucket and right-click a Tropical Fish.
ll8.info.tropicraft.knock_mask_off_ashen: Hit an Ashen in the Home Tree and right-click its dropped mask.
ll8.info.tropicraft.sift_sand_in_sifter: Craft a Sifter, place it, and right-click it holding Sand.
ll8.info.twilightdelight.serve_from_feas: Place Fiery Snakes Block, Lily Chicken Block, or Meef Wellington Block and right-click it with a bowl.
ll8.info.twilightforest.break_lich_tower: Break a Magic Painting found in a Lich Tower gallery.
ll8.info.twilightforest.silk_touch_skull: Place a mob head and right-click it with a candle for a Skull Candle block, then mine it with Silk Touch.
ll8.info.twilightforest.use_blank_map: Craft a Blank Map first, then hold it and right-click to map your surroundings.
ll8.info.ufo.fill_from_dma_tank: Run a fluid recipe in Dimensional Matter Assembler, then right-click with an empty bucket.
ll8.info.ufo.fill_from_me_network: Link Tier 3 Quantum Cryoforge to ME network, then click Stable Coolant in ME Terminal with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.ufo.open_loot_bundle: Right-click Loot bundles from FTB Quests rewards; each gives 3 random items, so odds of this one are very small.
ll8.info.umbral_skies.knight_phantom_bos: Defeat the Knight Phantoms in Twilight Forest's Knight Stronghold and claim Phantom Gauntlets from their boss loot.
ll8.info.undergarden.bucket_gwibling: Right-click a Gwibling with a Water Bucket in the Ancient Sea or Icy Sea of the Undergarden.
ll8.info.undergarden.fill_bucket_virulen: Right-click Virulent Mix source blocks in Undergarden bogs or Virulent Mix Cauldron with empty Bucket.
ll8.info.undergarden.trade_stoneborn: Trade 32 Regalium Crystals with a Stoneborn in the Undergarden; offers vary, so check multiple Stoneborn.
ll8.info.undergarden.use_anthem_disc_on_: Right-click a living Gloomper with a Music Disc (Gloomper Anthem); the disc is consumed.
ll8.info.utilitarian.bucket_a_small_slim: Right-click a small Slime with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.waystones.attune_on_warp_plate: Place a Warp Plate with a Dormant Shard, wait 1.5 seconds for it to attune, then take out the Attuned Shard.
ll8.info.waystones.bind_blank_scroll_on_: Craft a Blank Scroll and right-click a Waystone with it.
ll8.info.whaleborne.axe_off_whale_unders: Right-click the disc growth under a Hullback with any axe.
ll8.info.wildernature.accept_bounty_at_b: Craft a Bounty Board, place it, and accept one of its offered bounties.
ll8.info.wildernature.accept_commission_: Right-click a Bounty Board to select and accept a Guild Commission.
ll8.info.wildernature.blunderbuss: Accept the Big Game Hunter commission at a Bounty Board, kill 8 Elephants, then turn the contract in at the board.
ll8.info.wildernature.fur_cloak: Accept the Winter Pelt commission at a Bounty Board, kill 30 Swift Foxes, then turn the contract in at the board.
ll8.info.wildernature.guild_commission_e: Accept the Welcome to the Wild commission at a Bounty Board, stand in Plains, then turn the contract in at the board.
ll8.info.wildernature.shovel_infested_ro: Right-click an infested Rotten Log with a shovel to harvest Woodmeal from it.
ll8.info.wildernature.stylin_purple_hat: Accept the Huntin' in Style commission at a Bounty Board, stand in Savanna, then turn the contract in at the board.
ll8.info.wildernature.take_bounty_experi: Complete a bounty, turn in your contract at the board, and right-click the Burst of Experience.
ll8.info.wildernature.turkey_lays_egg: Keep Turkey on the ground; they'll drop Turkey Eggs every few minutes.
ll8.info.woot_revived.enchanted: Put Enchanted Books into a powered (FE) Enchanted Liquifier, then right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.woot_revived.mob_tears: Fill a powered (FE) Fluid Infuser with Water, add a mob drop, then right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.woot_revived.pure_dye: Feed a powered (FE) Dye Liquifier red, yellow, blue and white dyes, then right-click it with an empty Bucket.
ll8.info.xycraft_world.dye_placed_aurey_: Place an Aurey Block and right-click it with a dye.
ll8.info.xycraft_world.dye_placed_lamp: Place the white Lantern Lamp and right-click it with a dye.
ll8.info.xycraft_world.dye_placed_rgb_gl: Place the white RGB Viewer Glass and right-click it with a dye.
ll8.info.xycraft_world.dye_placed_rgb_la: Place the white RGB Lamp and right-click it with a dye.
ll8.info.xycraft_world.polish_aurey_with: Right-click an Aurey Block with a Stick to toggle its polish.
